Add a global (track) effect segment to the draft.

AGENT QUICKSTART (driving this as an agent? start here):
  Browse commands:  lyra-cli <domain> --help

USAGE:
  lyra-cli <domain> <[subdomain] ...> <action> [--flags] [--options]


OPTIONS:
  -h,     --help              Print this help message and exit
          --ref TEXT          Unified draft reference
          --resource TEXT     Effect resource: vimo://<id> / local://<path>
          --type TEXT         Effect material type: video_effect (default), face_effect, or
                              motiongraph
          --track TEXT        Target track index. Unitless whole-number index.
          --start <duration>  Timeline start, e.g. 0s. Explicit unit required: us, ms, s, or
                              min; bare numbers and m are invalid.
          --duration <duration> 
                              Duration, e.g. 3s. Explicit unit required: us, ms, s, or min;
                              bare numbers and m are invalid.
          --apply-type TEXT   Effect apply scope: 2 = global (whole track). Unitless
                              whole-number index.
          --dir TEXT          Optional parent directory for resolving or creating the draft
                              project folder.
          --name TEXT         MotionGraph timeline display name. Default: lumi_animation.
          --video-scope TEXT:{all,main} 
                              MotionGraph video scope: all or main. Default: all.
          --operation-id TEXT Optional MotionGraph idempotency and trace id generated by the
                              caller.
          --application-params TEXT 
                              Optional local motiongraph.application_params.v1 JSON file. It is
                              transported independently from runtime data.
          --application-params-json TEXT 
                              Optional structured application parameter overrides from target
                              XML. The apply stage validates and materializes them against the
                              package contract.
          --package-download-type TEXT 
                              Vimo download type used by apply-stage MotionGraph
                              auto-hydration.
          --package-platform TEXT 
                              Resource platform used by apply-stage MotionGraph auto-hydration.
          --package-test      Use the Vimo test environment for apply-stage MotionGraph
                              auto-hydration.
          --runtime-data-manifest TEXT 
                              Optional local runtime data manifest applied with the MotionGraph
                              package.
          --runtime-data-source TEXT 
                              Optional importer input JSON. The CLI first writes a standard
                              runtime_data_manifest, then applies it.
          --runtime-data-source-format TEXT 
                              Importer source format: plane_quad, four_point_plane_tracker,
                              device_plane_track_runtime, motiongraph_json,
                              lyra_mask_tracking_matting, lyra_ai_matting(deprecated),
                              runtime_data_manifest, or motiongraph_manifest.
          --runtime-key TEXT  MotionGraph runtime input key, e.g. device_plane or subject_mask.
          --runtime-data-output-dir TEXT 
                              Optional output directory for importer-generated
                              runtime_data_manifest. Defaults to a draft-local .lyra directory.
          --runtime-data-kind TEXT 
                              Optional runtime data kind override for generic source formats.
          --runtime-data-schema TEXT 
                              Optional runtime data schema override for generic source formats.
          --runtime-coordinate-space TEXT 
                              Optional coordinate space metadata for geometric runtime data.
          --runtime-source-timebase TEXT:{auto,effect_relative_us,draft_us,seconds,frame_index} 
                              Input runtime data timebase. Default: auto.
          --runtime-output-timebase TEXT:{effect_relative_us} 
                              Output runtime data timebase. Default: effect_relative_us.
          --runtime-material TEXT 
                              Optional source material identity written into runtime manifest
                              metadata.
          --runtime-data-file-name TEXT 
                              Optional converted runtime data JSON file name.
          --runtime-effect-start <duration> 
                              Effect start in draft time with an explicit unit, e.g. 0s or
                              1250ms. Used when --runtime-source-timebase=draft_us.
          --runtime-fps FLOAT Input fps. Required only when converting frame_index-only runtime
                              data.
          --runtime-target-json TEXT 
                              Optional JSON describing the runtime target (subject/plane) for
                              apply-stage auto-build of runtime data manifest.
          --target-material-id TEXT 
                              Optional target material id for apply-stage auto-build of runtime
                              data manifest.
          --target-segment-id TEXT 
                              Target draft segment id for apply-stage runtime tracking.
          --target-duration-us INT 
                              Whole target video/image segment duration in microseconds.
          --runtime-application-offset-us INT 
                              MotionGraph application start relative to the target segment in
                              microseconds. Blueprint supplies this for apply-stage
                              runtime-data windowing.
          --materials-xml TEXT 
                              Optional Materials XML context (path or inline) for apply-stage
                              auto-build of runtime data manifest.
  -v,     --version           Show version information and exit.
          --jq TEXT           Pretty-print JSON output; with an optional selector like
                              .result.items[0].id, output the selected JSON value instead of
                              the full schema envelope.

NOTE: this adds a global effect on an effect track.
      For a per-segment effect use `draft video effect add`.
EXAMPLES
  # Add a global visual effect over a 3s window
  $ lyra-cli draft effect add --resource vimo://123 --start 0s --duration 3s
  # Add a global face/person effect
  $ lyra-cli draft effect add --resource vimo://123 --type face_effect --start 0s --duration 3s
  # Add an Agent-authored local MotionGraph/Lumi package
  $ lyra-cli draft effect add --type motiongraph --resource local:///x/lumi.zip --start 0s --duration 3s
